rss: Flight chaos caused by software defect in the 'space of a millisecond', report says
title: App Glitch Cancels RC Car Races
story: A small glitch in the RC car app caused all the races to be cancelled, leaving racers and fans very upset. The company is working hard to fix the issue so everyone can race again.
storyBig: A minor software defect in the control app led to the cancellation of numerous remote control car races, affecting many participants and enthusiasts. The company is prioritizing a fix to resume normal operations.
think: How important is technology in toys like RC cars?
bull: When the app is fixed, races will be even better!
bear: If glitches continue, racers might lose interest.

rss: The virtual worlds where robots are trained
title: Robot Training in Virtual Worlds!
story: Robots are learning to do new things in pretend worlds. This helps them get ready for the real world. It's like practicing for a play before the big show!
storyBig: Robots are increasingly being trained in virtual environments to improve their real-world performance. This method allows for sophisticated skill development and adaptable learning processes.
think: What might robots learn better in a pretend world?
bull: Training in virtual worlds can make robots super smart!
bear: Some robots might take longer to learn than others.
